correctness.rationale: Under planar PPP Palm at origin, a mutual neighbor at y=rv_theta is admissible only if theta and theta+pi lie in the sector; Mecke integration and a Poisson void event over union rA_alpha ∪ (rv_theta+rA_alpha) give p(alpha)=(1/2)int_{mutual directions}1/U_alpha(theta)dtheta. Reflection yields the one-interval quadrature. No overlap for alpha<=pi, while uniform continuity of U near the vanishing arc and the half-disc lens area U_pi(pi/2)=2pi/3+sqrt(3)/4 yield the onset slope. Full-plane disc-union area gives pi/(4pi/3+sqrt(3)/2). Local finite-range truncation and Poisson variance O(area) imply convergence of empirical reciprocal-vertex density in probability, then L² by boundedness. Independently recomputed the exact onset and endpoint constants; finite calculations corroborate geometry only.
residual_risks: Fixed aperture and homogeneous planar Poisson law only; no uniform-in-aperture fluctuation/CLT result. Finite geometry cannot prove infinite L² theorem independently of local-score argument.
